'''Boro''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who underwent [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[flash training]] and served in [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="No Prisoners" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he participated in the [[Battle of JanFathal]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and helped rescue a [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent named [[Hallena Devis]].<ref name="No Prisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boro first appeared in the [[2009]] book ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="No Prisoners" />
